character.locked_description: A 10-year-old South Asian boy with a slender build, warm brown skin, and dark hair swept neatly to one side. He has a smooth, youthful face with dark, observant eyes. A sleek #5B4B8A purple hearing aid rests behind his left ear, blending seamlessly into his everyday look. He wears a navy tracksuit top featuring crisp #F0EFF4 white piping along the sleeves and collar, paired with matching navy tracksuit bottoms and #F0EFF4 white athletic sneakers. A folded #5B4B8A purple and #F0EFF4 white paper fortune-teller peeks out from his tracksuit pocket. At rest, he stands with a grounded, attentive posture, his hands held at waist level, ready to sign with quick, precise movements.
